theme: Which functions to paste in place
title: Paste and Fold: Chain-Aware Inlining Under an Instruction-Cache Budget
strategies: inline nothing, pay full call overhead and body cost everywhere (trivial baseline)

sort call sites by (frequency * call overhead) / inline size and greedily fill the icache budget, ignoring which call sites unlock constant-propagation bonuses downstream (greedy, the obvious recipe -- also the checker's own reference baseline)

recognize that a call site's true value is its OWN call-overhead saving PLUS every bonus its inlining unlocks further down its chain, so treat each unlock-chain as a bundle of dependent prefix choices and solve a grouped knapsack over those bundles under the icache cap, then probe a few bounded overshoots past the cap when the unlocked bonus outweighs the icache penalty (strong -- a reformulation from per-item value to post-optimization chain value)

true global optimum over which call sites to inline, jointly with how far over the icache cap to go, is a nonlinear coupled combinatorial search (the penalty multiplies the WHOLE dynamic cost, so overshoot decisions interact globally) -- open ceiling, uncovered
